Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a Creator Partner Manager to join our Podcast team in Mexico. You’ll build meaningful relationships with creators at different stages of their journey, from emerging talent to established voices, and help them get the most from Spotify.
You’ll manage a portfolio of creator partnerships, help creators use Spotify’s tools and monetization programs, and bring insights from the Mexican creator community back to teams across Spotify. This role brings together relationship management, creator strategy, data and a strong understanding of Mexico’s evolving content landscape.
description:
We’re looking for a Creator Partner Manager to join our Podcast team in Mexico. You’ll build meaningful relationships with creators at different stages of their journey, from emerging talent to established voices, and help them get the most from Spotify.

You’ll manage a portfolio of creator partnerships, help creators use Spotify’s tools and monetization programs, and bring insights from the Mexican creator community back to teams across Spotify. This role brings together relationship management, creator strategy, data and a strong understanding of Mexico’s evolving content landscape.

lists.content:
• Build and grow long-term relationships with a portfolio of podcast creators and other emerging creator formats.
  • Help new and existing creators make effective use of Spotify for Creators, analytics, audience development tools and monetization programs.
  • Develop creator engagement strategies that support content creation, consumption and audience growth on Spotify.
  • Work closely with business development, marketing, PR, analytics, product and editorial teams to deliver creator initiatives and go-to-market plans.
  • Use platform data and insights to help creators understand content performance, audience behavior and opportunities for growth.
  • Listen to creator feedback, identify common needs and share actionable insights with Spotify’s product teams.
  • Develop creator programs, training sessions and community events that help creators learn, connect and grow.
  • Stay close to changes in Mexico’s creator landscape, including emerging talent, formats, audience behaviors and industry developments, and turn those insights into opportunities for Spotify.

• You have experience working in creator or talent partnerships, content strategy, media, digital platforms or a related field.
  • You understand Mexico’s creator ecosystem, including podcasts, creators, agencies, production companies and relevant cultural and audience trends.
  • You know how to build trusted relationships with creators, talent, media partners or other external partners.
  • You’re comfortable using data and insights to shape a strategy, identify opportunities and communicate a clear story.
  • You communicate clearly in Spanish and English, both in writing and conversation.
  • You enjoy working across teams and can bring people together around shared creator and business goals.
  • You’re comfortable taking ownership of your work, setting priorities and making progress in an evolving environment.
  • You stay curious about how younger audiences discover and engage with content and understand how creator formats and behaviors continue to evolve.

• This role is based in Mexico City
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
